title: incident-bot: runbook quicklinks + SLO-correlation helpers for on-call diagnostics
author: Priya Raman
description: Add quicklinks to on-call runbooks from the incident-bot diagnostics panel and introduce SLO-correlation helpers used by the SLO Toolkit to prioritize runbook suggestions. Motivation: on recent incidents engineers reported friction navigating from diagnostics to the most relevant runbook sections and correlating SLO breaches with runbook triggers. This PR implements: 1) quicklink metadata in runbook registry with stable anchor generation; 2) UI hooks in incident-bot to display top-3 quicklinks with scoring by recent pager frequency and tag match; 3) SLO-correlation helpers that enrich diagnostics payloads with related SLOs and a score for relevance; 4) fallback behavior when runbook metadata is missing; 5) tests and migration script for existing runbook entries. Checklist: - [x] Add runbook quicklink schema and migration - [x] Implement scoring heuristics and caching - [x] Wire UI to incident-bot diagnostics payload - [x] Add unit/integration tests - [x] Update docs and examples. Related: ENG-4821 runbook quicklinks initiative, ENG-5042 SLO correlation spike. Non-breaking.
